answers.answer: AB = AC, so MX = MY (equal chords are equidistant from the center). MD = ME (radii). So XD = MD − MX = ME − MY = YE.

X is the midpoint of AB, so MX ⊥ AB. MY ⊥ AC, so m(∠MXB) = m(∠MYC) = 90°. MX = MY (equal chords), so in triangle MXY, m(∠MXY) = m(∠MYX) (base angles). Subtracting equal angles from 90° gives m(∠YXB) = m(∠XYC).
